_comment: Read by scripts/make_mesh.py, scripts/unit_patches.py and scripts/make_case.py. The values are the solved runs'. Metres, kelvin, kg/s, watts.
_boxes: x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1; the unit and the sofa are each written as one closed STL, their union, by make_mesh.py

ports._ports: faces of snappyHexMesh's unitWall patch moved into these patches by unit_patches.py, by face centre; the areas are checked to 1%

_massFlow: kg/s through the half unit: 343 CFM, the MSZ-GS12NA-U1's top cooling airflow, halved
_Q: W of sensible cooling in the half room: 12,000 BTU/h (3.52 kW) at a sensible heat factor of 0.77, 2.71 kW, halved
_direction: the jet's direction at the active slot: 15 degrees above horizontal (up) or 60 degrees below (down)
